Saved real responses from the public ATS APIs, captured 2026-11-25 with `curl` (User-Agent `job-radar/0.1`).
Records are unmodified. To keep the repo small, `lever_*.json` keep only the Indonesian postings plus the first five
others, `workable_amartha.json` keeps the first 60 jobs and `workable_ajaib.json` the first 30. Never hand-edit or invent records here (CLAUDE.md).

| File | Request |
|---|---|
| greenhouse_xendit.json | https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/xendit/jobs?content=true |
| lever_ninjavan.json | https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/ninjavan?mode=json |
| lever_lalamove.json | https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/lalamove?mode=json |
| workable_ajaib.json | https://www.workable.com/api/accounts/ajaib?details=true |
| workable_amartha.json | https://www.workable.com/api/accounts/amartha?details=true |
| workday_tiket_sitemap.xml | https://tiketdotcom.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/Tiket_Careers/siteMap.xml |
| workday_tiket_job_R-3422.html | https://tiketdotcom.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/Tiket_Careers/job/Jakarta-Indonesia/Accounting-Officer_R-3422 |
| workday_pwc_sitemap.xml | https://pwc.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/Global_Experienced_Careers/siteMap.xml (10 non-Indonesian + all 82 Jakarta/Surabaya entries of 3659) |
| workday_pwc_job_jakarta.html | https://pwc.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/Global_Experienced_Careers/job/Jakarta/Supply-Chain---Logistics-Transformation-Manager--Consulting-_776266WD |
